assemblies.name: HHKB 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: The 2u housing is molded into the HHKB shell and is not loaded as a loose part.

assemblies.name: HHKB Type-S 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: Loads for HHKB Type-S keyboards. The 2u housing is molded into the shell and is not loaded as a loose part.

assemblies.name: Realforce RC1 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: The 2u housing is molded into the Realforce RC1 shell and is not loaded as a loose part.

assemblies.name: Topre 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: Standard unsilenced loose 2u assembly used by keyboards including the Leopold FC660C and FC980C.

assemblies.name: Topre Silenced 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: The slider has no ring seat; the housing provides 1.0 mm of ring space. Changing the ring must be evaluated by the same chatter and compression calculation as other silenced assemblies.

assemblies.name: NovaTouch 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: Factory NovaTouch loose 2u housing and slider with 4.0 mm nominal travel and no silencing ring.

assemblies.name: Deskeys 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: Manufacturer starting point uses the Deskeys 0.7 mm Poron ring for both 1u and 2u sliders.

assemblies.name: DynaCaps 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: Manufacturer starting point uses the recommended DynaCaps 0.5 mm Silicone ring for both 1u and 2u sliders.
assemblies.evidenceBasis: Owner correction on 2026-09-03 supersedes the workbook ring choice; the 0.5 mm Silicone ring recommendation and 1u/2u fit values are published by OmniType at https://omnitype.com/products/dynacap-silencing-rings.

assemblies.name: KLC 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: Manufacturer starting point explicitly uses no silencing ring on either the 1u or 2u slider.

assemblies.name: MetaKeebs 2u Stabilizer Assembly
notes: Manufacturer starting point uses the MetaKeebs 0.5 mm Poron ring for both 1u and 2u sliders; the underlying catalog parts retain their MetaPulse names.
